The big number of standard products, which have been adopted to customer specific requirements and the continuous extension of the product range with new customer tailored connector-systems, show clearly, how important terms like "flexibility" and "customer relation" are for ASSMANN WSW and their success on the market.
about:
Assmann WSW Components Inc. operates from Phoenix, Arizona, as the U.S. subsidiary of the German connector specialist Assmann WSW components GmbH. The company provides a broad portfolio of standard and custom interconnect solutions from its Phoenix facility.

Its product range spans thousands of connector part numbers across categories including board-to-board, wire-to-board, wire-to-wire, circular, D-SUB, DIN, USB, FFC/FPC, modular, and micro-miniature connectors, as well as terminal blocks, IC sockets, and battery connectors. The company also supplies thermal management components and customized cable assemblies. Standard offerings cover pin counts from 1 to 100, contact spacings from 0.3 mm to 17 mm, current ratings up to 65 A, and termination styles such as crimp, IDC, press-fit, surface mount, through-hole reflow, solder cup, and wire wrap.

The input does not identify specific industries or customer types; the company's connector and cable assembly products are generally suited for electronics manufacturers across multiple sectors.

Assmann WSW emphasizes flexibility and customer relation as keys to its market success, highlighting a continuous expansion of its standard product range and the adaptation of standard items to customer-specific requirements, all while maintaining quality, technology, and pricing aligned with market demands.

about:
Assured Automotive Company operates from Mesa, Arizona, and has been in the automotive industry since 1991. The company sells truck and SUV accessories through its e-commerce site, AssuredAutomotiveProducts.com, serving individual owners and enthusiasts directly.

The retailer stocks accessories for Ford, Chevrolet, GMC, Dodge, Ram, Jeep, Nissan, and Toyota trucks and SUVs, plus Polaris, Yamaha, and Can-Am side-by-side UTVs. Product categories include air horns, on-board air systems, LED lighting, bed covers, cold air intakes, programmers and tuners, suspension components, performance parts, and interior/exterior accessories. Brands carried range from Rigid Industries and Viair to Air Lift, Firestone, Timbren, and S&B Filters, alongside a private-label Assured Performance line of air horns and exhaust components. Every listed item is kept in inventory, and the company reports an average handling time of less than one business day.

Customers span the automotive aftermarket, truck and SUV accessory, off-road, and UTV/ATV segments. The site provides vehicle-specific fitment search by year (1990–2027), make, model, engine, drive type, and bed length, allowing buyers to locate parts for exact configurations.

Assured Automotive Company emphasizes post-sale support, stating that competitors often forget buyers after the sale while its staff promises continued service. It offers price matching and sometimes beats competitor dealer prices, provides phone access to knowledgeable sales executives on weekdays, and processes payments securely via PayPal and major credit cards.

old_description: AssureLink®, LLC is a locally owned and operated business whose primary goal is to assist the elderly or individuals with unique medical needs live as independently as possible, by offering medical alarms that will summon needed help at the “push of a button”. These alert buttons are available as an In-Home device for those who spend the majority of their time at home or around their house, or as a mobile cellular device for those who get out and about. The mobile unit will work anywhere there is adequate cellular service. Both devices are Medicaid-reimbursable for eligible participants.
about:
AssureLink, LLC is based in Idaho Falls, Idaho, where it operates as a locally owned and operated business. The company was founded to help elderly individuals and those with unique medical needs maintain independence through medical alert systems, though the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed. The owners established the business out of concern for people at risk of losing their independence due to age, disability, or recovery from medical conditions.

The company provides two types of medical alert devices: an in-home unit designed for those who spend most of their time at home, and a mobile cellular unit that functions anywhere with adequate cellular coverage. Both devices are Medicaid-reimbursable for eligible participants. AssureLink does not disclose manufacturing operations, facility size, or employee count, indicating it likely functions as a distributor or service provider rather than a manufacturer.

AssureLink serves individuals in the senior care and home healthcare markets, including elderly persons, those with limited mobility, patients recuperating from medical conditions, and residents of rural areas where emergency response may be delayed. The company does not list specific industry verticals or B2B clients, focusing instead on direct-to-consumer and caregiver sales.

The business was started on the principle that everyone deserves to live independently with the assurance that help is available at the push of a button. AssureLink emphasizes its local ownership and commitment to customers who may be isolated or at risk, positioning itself as a compassionate provider rather than a volume-driven supplier.

name: Astemo Americas, Inc. Berea Plant No. 2
old_description: Astemo Americas Joins NVIDIA DRIVE Hyperion Ecosystem as Tier-1 Partner
about:
Astemo Americas, Inc. operates its Berea Plant No. 2 in Berea, Kentucky. The facility traces its roots to 1986, and the current corporate entity was formed in January 2021 when Hitachi Automotive Systems, Keihin, Showa, and Nissin Kogyo merged to create the global mega-supplier Astemo. The plant is a manufacturing site within Astemo's North American footprint.

The company develops and manufactures automotive components across four core domains: electric powertrains, advanced chassis systems, autonomous driving and advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), and motorcycle systems. It also supplies aftermarket products and provides sales and engineering support from offices such as the recently opened East Liberty location. A major expansion of manufacturing operations in Kentucky was announced in 2026.

Astemo serves automotive OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers, with concrete engagements including a Tier-1 partnership in the NVIDIA DRIVE Hyperion ecosystem for autonomous driving and an INDYCAR program with Team Penske and Chevrolet. Its customer base extends to motorsports teams and the aftermarket channel.

The company states its mission is to provide a safe, sustainable, and comfortable mobility life through technologies that contribute to an advanced and sustainable society, aiming to reduce traffic accidents, congestion, and environmental impact through cleaner exhaust and improved fuel efficiency.

name: Atlantic Poly Inc
old_description: Atlantic Poly, Inc. is a New England based polyethylene supplier and national wholesale distributor of plastic products including:
about:
Atlantic Poly Inc is headquartered in Norwood, Massachusetts, and was founded in 1981. The company operates as a New England–based polyethylene supplier and national wholesale distributor of plastic bags, films, and packaging products.

The product line encompasses a broad range of polyethylene and specialty bags, including custom printed bags, gusseted bags, high-density bags, recycled-content bags, anti-static bags, mil-spec bags, clean-room ISO-certified bags, stretch film, bubble wrap, pallet covers, zip-lock bags, shrink bags, construction film, dry-cleaning bags, grocery bags, heat-seal systems, poly tubing, and water-soluble bags. The company offers customization services such as printing, gusseting, side welding, bottom sealing, perforating, wicketing, and co-extrusion. It serves both small and large orders with no stated minimum order quantity and maintains a customer service team whose representatives each have at least 15 years of packaging industry experience. Atlantic Poly also leverages a network of other manufacturers to source items it does not produce in-house.

Customers span medical device packaging (including Aclar bags for long-term storage), electronics manufacturing (anti-static nylon bags), military and defense (mil-spec packaging), construction (vapor barrier films), retail (grocery and shopping bags), dry cleaning, industrial packaging, and clean-room environments.

The company promotes an “Eco-Green” seal, highlighting recycled and biodegradable bag options to help clients meet environmental standards. It positions itself as a poly bag expert specializing in customization and relies on its supplier network to fulfill requirements beyond its own production capabilities.

name: Atlas Metal Works LLC
about:
Atlas Metal Works LLC operates from South Windsor, Connecticut, as a CT DAS Certified Small Business Enterprise. The company runs a custom metal fabrication house serving the commercial market, though its founding year and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides end-to-end fabrication from design through finished parts, including laser cutting, high-definition plasma cutting, shearing, press-brake forming, CNC punching, pipe rolling and bending, polishing, sawing, and multiple welding processes (MIG, TIG, flux-core, spot, stud, and aluminum MIG). Key equipment includes a BLM LS5 12 kW plate laser cutting 5-by-10-foot plates up to one inch thick, a Vectis UR20 cobot welder with 48-inch reach, two AccurPress brakes (320-ton by 12-foot and 175-ton by 10-foot), an AccurShear with 1/4-inch by 12-foot capacity, a 55-ton Euromac CNC punch, a Timesaver 8-inch stainless polisher, Hypertherm and Thermadyne high-definition plasma systems, and a Marvel 18-inch automated saw. The company also stocks and sells raw sheet, plate, angle, and channel cut to size.

Customers span OEM manufacturers, general contractors, construction firms, and other fabrication houses that need supplemental capacity. Work ranges from commercial and residential projects to industrial applications, with the shop handling everything from gauge sheet to heavy plate in stainless steel, aluminum, carbon steel, galvanized, brass, and copper.

Atlas Metal Works positions itself as a gap-filler for manufacturers lacking in-house shearing, bending, laser cutting, welding, or hole-punching capacity. It accepts customer design files in AutoCAD, FastCAM, or FastSHAPES formats and can also create designs in-house, aiming to deliver accurate parts on schedule for both large and small projects.

name: Atlas Wire, LLC
old_description: Atlas Wire, LLC has served the electronic, OEM, and distribution markets since 1966.
about:
Atlas Wire, LLC was founded in 1966 in Itasca, Illinois. The company began as a supplier to the electronic, OEM, and distribution markets and has since expanded to operate a second facility in Tucson, Arizona. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company manufactures PVC, XLPE (cross-linked polyethylene), and nylon insulated electrical lead wires in single and multi-conductor constructions, covering sizes from 4 to 30 AWG. Its capabilities include extrusion, spiral striping, longitudinal line extrusion, twisting, heat bonding, respooling, and custom drum or spool packaging. Atlas Wire has produced over 4,900 distinct wire types across its two plants.

Atlas Wire serves the electronics, automotive, military, appliance, building and fixture, and industrial machinery sectors. Customers include OEMs and distributors that require UL-recognized appliance wire, machine tool wire, low-voltage automotive primary wire and battery cable, military hookup wire, and PVC-insulated building wire.

The company emphasizes a service-oriented approach, citing low minimum order quantities, short production lead times, and a willingness to accommodate special requirements as key differentiators. Its quality system is certified to ISO 9001 and IATF 16949.

name: Austin Joinery
old_description: Austin Joinery has worked on two separate projects for me - media storage in an upstairs media room, and a wall-to-wall custom bookcase for my home office. Matt is a joy to work with as he took each project from concept to completion easily, with great communication along the way. The projects themselves were relatively easy to conceptualize - media shelves had to conform to a DVD case's dimensions, and the bookcase "columns" would need to conform to IKEA 30" by 10" shelves. What took the concepts above and beyond were Matt's keen eye and expertise in his field - his rapid feedback from my 3D models helped him understand what I wanted and if any adjustments needed to be made along the way. I couldn't be happier with the results and I would recommend Matt and Austin Joinery time and time again!
about:
Austin Joinery operates from Pflugerville, Texas, a suburb north of Austin. The shop is owned and run by Matt, who founded the business to provide custom furniture built around each client’s space and needs.

The company designs and builds one‑off furniture pieces—dining tables with leaves, bookcases, consoles, bed frames, game tables, and media storage—using domestic hardwoods such as red oak, walnut, maple, ash, and pecan. Matt oversees every project from initial concept and computer‑generated drawings through joinery, finishing with stains and clear coats, and final installation. The shop also incorporates metal accents and upholstery sourced from specialists.

Clients range from homeowners furnishing media rooms, offices, and dining areas to interior design firms including Nine Design Group, Cameron Getter Design, and C&H Design Studio. Projects often involve fitting pieces to exact dimensions, matching existing furniture, or repairing heirloom items.

The firm emphasizes personal service: Matt takes measurements himself, provides free quotes, and communicates throughout the build. Customers cite reasonable pricing, meticulous craftsmanship, and the ability to correct work from other makers as reasons they return.

It maintains three locations and offers online parts ordering with search by make, model, part number, or VIN. No facility size, headcount, or volume figures are published.

Auto Parts Company serves automotive repair shops, collision centers, and individual customers across the Midwest and nationwide. It ships via UPS or common carrier throughout the United States and provides free delivery to a broad corridor including St. Louis, Hannibal, Quincy, Columbia, Jefferson City, Rolla, Springfield, Joplin, Branson, Fayetteville, Tulsa, and Bentonville.

The company emphasizes its 90-day warranty on all parts, decades of customer-service experience, and a multi-location network as key differentiators. It was built to provide both the part and the support needed for automotive repair.
